dialog: I'll show you the power of the Palanquin Ship!
Let's try attacking them from here.
It's time to fight. Are you ready?!
Uh oh/ I've gotta hold on to something...
Enemy ahead!
We'll soon make contact with the enemy.
Wait/ is there still more fighting to do?!
Naturally!
The autopilot is functioning normally. Executing maneuvers!
Get the ship in position/ now!
Sorry/ but we're not just going to sit here and take it!
We'll have our say too!
They're within our firing range!
Looks like they're still near us!
Then let's fire back!
At this distance we can catch up with them!
Mr. Kourindou/ the enemy is running away!
Not if we don't let them!
Machine guns/ full auto!
This should be enough to hold them back!
Firing a spread of danmaku!
Please fire the machine guns!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ fire!
Spirit Cannons/ fire a volley!
Auxiliary Spirit Cannons/ make all guns ready!
Firing the main gun/ keep out of the way!
Now's our chance! Give them everything we've got!
The main armament is prepared to fire!
Bring the buddhist reactor to full power!
Mr. Kourindou/ it's ready!
Fire!
The main armament is ready now!
Targeting complete/ good to fire!
Fire!!!
Prepare to fire the Spirit Cannon!
It's ready!
Let's go!
Captain Murasa left us this...
Firing the anchor!
Now's the time! All guns/ fire at will!
Power output rising/ we're ascending!
Drop anchor!
All guns/ fire a volley!
We'll secure the ship's hull in place/ then bombard them!
Dropping the anchor!
Concentrated fire!
Looks like we have no choice but to use it.
Firing the Heavy Buddhist Missile.\n Everyone nearby/ please take cover!
Arming complete/ adjusting angle of fire...
I'll handle correcting the aim.\n Mr. Kourindou/ you have the trigger!
Missile/ direct fire!
The target is completely silent...
What awe-inspiring power...
We're using the Heavy Buddhist Missile.\n Warn everyone nearby/ please.
Blast warning!\n Everyone/ please evacuate to a distance of 1000!
Trajectory calculations complete.
With me pulling the trigger/ it can't fail!
Ignition!
The target has been completely silenced!
We probably shouldn't use this thing too much...
Let's rise/ we can do some precision fire from above.
The target has entered our firing range!
Sound the alarm!\n We're using the Heavy Buddhist Missile!
Confirming our allies' withdrawal...\n Aim correction/ complete!
Fire missiles!
Direct hit confirmed. Our allies are okay.
Let's just get ourselves out of the fire.
Get us back in position!
We can't attack while at this angle...
We got taken for a ride/ so to speak...
Wh- where'd that attack come from?!
Targeting systems show nothing in range!
Kosuzu! What's the range to the enemy?!
... Looks far/ Mr. Kourindou!
We're bound by duty to see this through/ now.
We've come to provide assistance.\n Please give us some room!
Leave the rest up to us.
That was a good one!
Mr. Kourindou/ let's screen them with the Palanquin Ship.
We'll protect our allies with the ship itself!
Murasa/ this isn't going to help you fulfill your ambition at all!
Palanquin Ship/ follow up after me!
This is a nice position to be in.
Follow up with another attack from the ship!
We're on it/ Murasa.
Murasa/ we came to check up on you.
Murasa/ we'll handle it from here.
Murasa made a window of opportunity for us!
Murasa gave us a good chance!
Palanquin Ship/ come here!
Good/ looks like we were in time.
Sorry/ Palanquin Ship―Protect me!
We're here to aid you/ Murasa.
Taking care of the ship is fine/\n but you've got to take care of yourself too!
Murasa/ we're here to rescue you!
It's actually quite novel to get to protect you/ Murasa.
Murasa/ watch out!
We'll fight on in Keine's stead!
Keine gave us a good chance!
Keine made a window of opportunity for us!
It's actually quite novel to get to protect you/ Keine.
We should come to Keine's aid!
Thank goodness...\n That attack's exactly the same as one in my knowledge.
Brilliant as always/ Akyu.
Mr. Kourindou/ dodge upwards!
Got it!
Mr. Kourindou/ they're coming in from starboard!
Taking evasive action!
Mr. Kourindou/ port side!
If I leave it up to the autopilot―
Mr. Kourindou/ dodge upwards!
Taking evasive action!
Hard to port/ hey!
P- please don't suddenly spin the wheel!
Hard to starboard/ hey!
W- whoa! Well... it's all good...
There's nothing to worry about if it's like this.
Yeah/ let's keep on fighting!
We've taken only superficial damage!
Did we just take a hit?
Only a scratch.
Looks like it's not a problem at all.
The Palanquin Ship sure is something/ isn't it?
Hull integrity is dropping!
We're going to have to do some things manually now!
At this rate/ even the Palanquin Ship is going to―
We're losing power from the buddhist reactor!\n At this rate/ we're going to―
Try to stabilize the hull!
I'm on it!
Ugh/ and we were trusted with the ship...
Help with damage control!
Understood/ sealing bulkheads!
W- wow/ we're really rocking back and forth...
A few more of those and we'll be in some trouble...
We're borrowing this thing/ we better take care of it...
We were hit?!
I- is this normal?!
We've taken fire/ but there are no problems with hull integrity!
Perhaps our battleplan was overly optimistic.
Give me a damage report!
We've taken fire near the number three hatch!
This is a good ship/ she'll be fine!
Our flank is currently grazing!
We grazed it?!
Wh- Whoaaa!
Kosuzu/ keep your head down!
I'm glad we have an autopilot mode...
I'll speed up until we lose them!
Bringing us about hard!
I have a contact incoming on radar/ please avoid it!
At least for now/ we're safe and sound.
This is the full power of Myouren's Flying Granary...
Barrier functioning normally...\n No damage reported!
It really is amazingly powerful.
As long as we've got this barrier!
Just what I'd expect from the Palanquin Ship.
How's the barrier's uptime?
Operating flawlessly!
It really is a superb artifact.
Wow!\n So this is what a 'barrier' is!
Here we go!
Putting us ahead of the enemy. Ready!
Just where I was aiming for.
Aww...
Sorry/ this one is my fault...
This isn't good! We can't take this much longer...
We- we're done for. The Palanquin Ship...
Seems like we were good sparring partners.
Save that energy for visiting the Bazaar.
That's Hakurei Shrine for you/ with us immediately running into some odd new youkai...
You seem well-mannered.\n Maybe I want to listen to you just a little...
She's a celestial/ huh. Seems like she has a rather warped personality/ though.
There's still not enough information about how you Celestials live in Heaven yet.
Closing off her line of retreat...
You're actually a youkai that isn't within my knowledge.
Nue/ please listen to us!
If you won't listen to reason/ we might need to get rough...
You won't get away with this/ Mehko!
We'll get around her one way or another!
Could this have been us?
I'm glad I don't have to write a Gensokyo Chronicle that reads like this.
It's like they're pure evil thoughts made manifest.
Mehko/ please get out of our way!
Her spirit levels aren't high/ but...
What you're doing is far too dangerous!
Well/ I'd better make you give up a little sooner!
If you're not going to go down/ then we also need to...
Mehko/ please/ let's stop this!
We'll be taking back Gensokyo's dreams!
So this is what the dreamspirit fountain looks like...
I can't back down/ not when my beloved Gensokyo hangs in the balance!
There's nothing to do but throw everything we've got at her!
We'll be taking back the Dream World!
I can't back down/ not when my beloved Gensokyo hangs in the balance!
There's nothing to do but throw everything we've got at her!
